instruction: Turn off the BCC feature for all outgoing emails to stop blind carbon copies from being sent automatically.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling automatic BCC (blind carbon copy) in Thunderbird email composition settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric to verify that mail.identity.id1.doBcc is set to false. Verified against actual prefs.js file from cache - current value is false, task requires keeping/setting it to false.
metadata.verification: Read actual prefs.js from extracted cache: mail.identity.id1.doBcc is currently false. Task asks to disable BCC, which means setting doBcc to false.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same type of preference modification in Thunderbird, same complexity level (changing a single boolean preference)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies and checks the right Thunderbird preference (mail.identity.id1.doBcc) for BCC functionality
